messages:
alex_cs: drafting customer note for affected accounts. quick review please — want to be concise: summary, root cause, mitigation, timeline, next steps, credits, and office hours.

maria_eng: root cause: a config rollout changed queue shard assignment and caused a throttled indexing worker group at ~03:12 UTC. rollback at 03:40 UTC. backfill running; throughput at ~85% of normal. estimate full catch-up in 6-8 hours depending on bursts.

jamie_pm: add a renewal-sensitive paragraph to trigger AE/SEP touch for customers in renewal window. offer a 30-minute migration/implementation review + one-time credit. tone: apologetic and action-oriented.

alex_cs: initial outbound draft below — please edit inline.

alex_cs: ```Hi <Customer>,
Weare sorry. Between ~03:10 and 03:40 UTC today a configuration change impacted our indexing pipeline, delaying processing of new uploads and trial imports. We reverted the change and initiated a backfill; processing is progressing and we expect full catch-up within 6-8 hours.

What happened: a queue-shard config mismatch caused a subset of indexing workers to be throttled (incident INC-2026-17855).
What we did: rolled back the rollout, scaled backfill workers by 3x, patched the shard config, and are monitoring catch-up.
What youre likely to see: no data loss. Search and embedding completeness will return once the backfill completes.
Next steps: well host two office hours today (1500 and 1900 UTC) for affected customers. Were offering a one-time account credit capped at X for impacted onboarding windows. If youre in a renewal window or need prioritized help, reply and well arrange a dedicated session with our solutions engineering and your AE.
Apologies for the disruption and thanks for your patience.
— Alex, Customer Success```

maria_eng: small wording changes: replace "scaled backfill workers by 3x" with "scaled up backfill workers by 3x". also request we include incident id and link to internal incident doc. ops bot posted public status link already.

ops_bot: INC-2026-17855 status: RESOLVED (rollback + backfill). public reference: https://redwood.status/incidents/INC-2026-17855 :white_check_mark:

alex_cs: updated draft with edits and link placeholder.

jamie_pm: I'll flag renewal accounts and ping AEs. add sentence offering a 30-minute review for renewal customers and volunteer to join escalations.

sophia_se: I can host the two office hours (1500 & 1900 UTC). please attach short RSVP form and a troubleshooting checklist for customers to run before joining; Il capture feedback and common issues during the sessions.

alex_cs: checklist before send: 1) legal sign-off on credit wording (maria to confirm) 2) append priority list with renewal flags 3) include RSVP + calendar invites 4) SEP/AE handoff tags added. target send: 10:00 UTC.

maria_eng: legal okay as long as we cap language "up to X credits". legal will DM exact phrasing in 10m.

alex_cs: thanks. will post the final outbound here for a last spot check before we send. also adding a short feedback checkbox to capture whether the outage affected renewal decisions. :thumbsup:
